text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
(A dry texture lacking moisture.
And along with that, a chaotic lack of cohesion as each flavor asserts itself separately on the tongue...)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
First, perhaps we should promote
the introduction of a new rice cooker...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "It seems she ended up eating hard rice, which she dislikes, and felt downhearted."
